description: 添加一个工具来统计本地文件的行数和字符数，并在统计后告知用户。

diff_stats.short_summary: 改动 1 个文件，+31 / -0 行

diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/core/tools/file_stats.py
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+"""文件统计工具：统计文件行数和字符数。"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+from utils.file_utils import normalize_path
+from core.tools.base import tool
+
+
+@tool(
+    name="file.stats",
+    description="统计一个文本文件的行数和字符数，返回结果文本。",
+    params_schema={
+        "type": "object",
+        "properties": {
+            "path": {"type": "string", "description": "文件绝对路径"},
+        },
+        "required": ["path"],
+    },
+    risk_level="low",
+    category="file",
+)
+def file_stats(path: str) -> str:
+    p = normalize_path(path)
+    if not os.path.exists(p):
+        return f"文件不存在: {p}"
+    with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
+        content = f.read()
+    line_count = content.count("\n") + (0 if content.endswith("\n") else 1) if content else 0
+    char_count = len(content)
+    return f"文件 {p}：{line_count} 行，{char_count} 字符"
